nodes.label: OpenWrt Grafana Monitor Project
nodes.definition: Full observability stack for OpenWrt routers using Grafana OTEL-LGTM and Grafana Alloy for metrics, logs, and dashboards

nodes.label: Docker Compose Observability Stack
nodes.definition: Containerized monitoring infrastructure with otel-lgtm (Grafana + Prometheus + Loki + Tempo) and Grafana Alloy services

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml
nodes.definition: Docker Compose configuration file that defines otel-lgtm, Alloy, and optional openwrt-ssh-mcp services

nodes.label: otel-lgtm Service
nodes.definition: All-in-one Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo service providing metrics database, logs database, traces, and UI

nodes.label: Grafana Alloy Service
nodes.definition: Telemetry collector service that scrapes OpenWrt metrics, drops unbounded node_nat_traffic, receives syslog, and forwards data to Prometheus and Loki

nodes.label: openwrt-ssh-mcp Service
nodes.definition: Optional guarded SSH MCP sidecar exposing allowlisted router diagnostics and monitoring operations to Claude Code and other tools

nodes.label: alloy/config.alloy
nodes.definition: Alloy configuration file containing router target discovery, metric scraping, syslog reception, and telemetry forwarding

nodes.label: Grafana Provisioning Configuration
nodes.definition: Auto-provisioned Grafana datasources (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo), dashboards, and alerting rules

nodes.label: Prometheus Datasource
nodes.definition: Grafana datasource (uid: prometheus) pointing to Prometheus at http://localhost:9090 for metrics with 30s interval

nodes.label: Loki Datasource
nodes.definition: Grafana datasource (uid: loki) pointing to Loki at http://localhost:3100 for logs with maxLines: 1000

nodes.label: Tempo Datasource
nodes.definition: Grafana datasource (uid: tempo) pointing to Tempo at http://localhost:3200 for traces

nodes.label: Classic Dashboards
nodes.definition: Four classic dashboards (Overview, Network, Devices, Logs) generated from build_dashboards.py

nodes.label: build_dashboards.py
nodes.definition: Python dashboard generator for classic four dashboards, writes provisioning JSON files

nodes.label: V2 Dashboards
nodes.definition: Five V2 Grafana dashboards: Operations, Clients, Advanced, Topology, and Mission Control generated from build_openwrt_*_dashboard.py

nodes.label: build_openwrt_operations_dashboard.py
nodes.definition: Python generator for Operations V2 dashboard

nodes.label: build_openwrt_clients_dashboard.py
nodes.definition: Python generator for Clients V2 dashboard using client_info identity series

nodes.label: build_openwrt_advanced_dashboard.py
nodes.definition: Python generator for Advanced V2 dashboard covering nftables traffic, WiFi mesh, Netifyd DPI

nodes.label: build_openwrt_topology_dashboard.py
nodes.definition: Python generator for Topology V2 dashboard

nodes.label: build_openwrt_mission_control.py
nodes.definition: Python generator for Mission Control dashboard

nodes.label: OpenWrt Router Setup
nodes.definition: Router-side installation and configuration using openwrt/setup.sh with POSIX shell and Lua collectors

nodes.label: openwrt/setup.sh
nodes.definition: POSIX shell installer script for OpenWrt collectors, helper scripts, profiles, syslog, and textfile metrics

nodes.label: openwrt/collectors/
nodes.definition: Lua 5.1 collectors loaded by prometheus-node-exporter-lua (device_status, packet_loss, wan_info, device_traffic, wifi_dethrash, dpi_netifyd, client_inventory)

nodes.label: openwrt/scripts/
nodes.definition: POSIX shell textfile helper scripts run from cron for custom metrics (WAN quality, filesystem, services, etc.)

nodes.label: openwrt/nftables/
nodes.definition: Optional nftables rules for per-device traffic accounting

nodes.label: Router Profiles
nodes.definition: Optional installation profiles: core (default), traffic, wifi_mesh, dpi, clients, full - each adds focused collectors without hard dependencies

nodes.label: core Profile
nodes.definition: Default profile with existing official collectors and repo helper scripts

nodes.label: traffic Profile
nodes.definition: Optional profile adding read-only nftables per-device byte and packet counters via device_traffic.lua collector

nodes.label: wifi_mesh Profile
nodes.definition: Optional profile adding radio settings, 802.11r/k/v flags, and usteer local metrics via wifi_dethrash.lua

nodes.label: dpi Profile
nodes.definition: Optional profile adding bounded Netifyd application/protocol snapshot metrics via dpi_netifyd.lua

nodes.label: clients Profile
nodes.definition: Optional profile adding unified per-client identity, conntrack occupancy, nlbwmon MAC-keyed service traffic, and WiFi roaming visibility

nodes.label: full Profile
nodes.definition: Aggregated profile enabling all optional profiles (traffic, wifi_mesh, dpi, clients)

nodes.label: client_inventory.lua Collector
nodes.definition: MAC-keyed unified client identity source merging DHCP, UCI static leases, WiFi APs, and network zones with lowercase colon-separated MACs

nodes.label: device_traffic.lua Collector
nodes.definition: Reads nftables per-device byte and packet counters, joins with DHCP hostnames, replaces unbounded node_nat_traffic

nodes.label: wifi_dethrash.lua Collector
nodes.definition: Exports radio channel, frequency, transmit power, 802.11r/k/v configuration, and usteer local load/roam/client metrics

nodes.label: dpi_netifyd.lua Collector
nodes.definition: Reads Netifyd local status.json snapshot exporting active flows, device count, top application bytes/flows, top protocol flows (capped 25 per scrape)

nodes.label: client_conntrack Collector
nodes.definition: Per-minute bash/Lua collector exporting bounded per-client conntrack entries and WiFi association events

nodes.label: client_traffic Collector
nodes.definition: Per-minute bash/Lua collector reading nlbwmon JSON exporting bounded per-client bytes_total, packets_total, connections_total by service

nodes.label: OpenWrt SSH MCP Sidecar
nodes.definition: Guarded SSH MCP sidecar for Claude Code/Codex exposing allowlisted diagnostics and monitoring operations with static bearer token auth

nodes.label: mcp_server/core.py
nodes.definition: MCP server policy module defining allowlist, command construction, and policy boundaries

nodes.label: mcp_server/server.py
nodes.definition: HTTP/MCP service implementation for the guarded sidecar

nodes.label: mcp_server/Dockerfile
nodes.definition: Docker build configuration for MCP sidecar with pinned Python dependencies

nodes.label: mcp_server/requirements.txt
nodes.definition: Python dependencies: mcp 1.28.1, paramiko 5.0.0, uvicorn[standard] 0.51.0

nodes.label: MCP Allowlisted Tools
nodes.definition: 10 allowlisted MCP tools: openwrt_list_routers, openwrt_ssh_check, openwrt_system_facts, openwrt_monitoring_status, openwrt_metrics_sample, openwrt_diagnostic, openwrt_send_test_log, openwrt_restart_monitoring, openwrt_configure_syslog, openwrt_run_repo_setup

nodes.label: Kubernetes Monitoring Setup
nodes.definition: Alternative deployment guide for using existing Kubernetes monitoring stack (Prometheus Operator, Grafana, Loki) instead of Docker Compose

nodes.label: .env Configuration
nodes.definition: Environment variable configuration with ROUTER_IP, ROUTER_TARGETS, MONITORING_HOST_IP, SCRAPE_INTERVAL, GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD, SYSLOG_PORT

nodes.label: ROUTER_TARGETS Multi-Router Support
nodes.definition: Comma-separated multi-target format (name=ip:port,name=ip:port) for monitoring multiple OpenWrt routers with distinct router labels while maintaining job=openwrt

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Pattern
nodes.definition: Convention: every collector emits ..._available 0 gauge when its dependency is missing instead of emitting nothing

nodes.label: Metric Naming Convention
nodes.definition: Convention: openwrt_* prefix for repo-owned metrics, legacy alias metrics kept for older dashboards, _seconds suffix for durations not timestamps

nodes.label: MAC Address Normalization
nodes.definition: Canonical form: lowercase colon-separated MACs in new collectors, differs from dhcp_lease/uci_dhcp_host uppercase convention for intentional join prevention

nodes.label: Bounded Cardinality Pattern
nodes.definition: Design principle: never ship a metric that reports plausible wrong value, state cardinality cost of every new label, bound unbounded metrics

nodes.label: P0: textfile_dir Not Configured
nodes.definition: Critical bug: setup.sh never sets prometheus-node-exporter-lua.main.textfile_dir, causing silent loss of all custom metrics if default differs from /var/prometheus

nodes.label: P0: Profile Downgrade Not Idempotent
nodes.definition: Critical bug: rerunning setup with narrower profile (e.g., full→core) leaves wider profile's collectors, cron jobs, nft rules, and protocols file in place

nodes.label: P0: conntrack-tools Missing Dependency
nodes.definition: Critical bug: clients profile depends on conntrack-tools but setup.sh never installs it, causing conntrack collector to permanently fail-close

nodes.label: Flow Offload Invalidates Traffic Accounting
nodes.definition: Known limitation: software and hardware flow offload bypass firewall counter updates, making nlbwmon and nftables traffic accounting unreliable

nodes.label: flow_offload Read Unreliable
nodes.definition: Live audit 2026-07-23: openwrt_flow_offload_enabled sample absent 90-97% of scrapes due to UCI read failure, hardened with openwrt_flow_offload_read_success gauge

nodes.label: Duplicate Series Risk
nodes.definition: Prometheus silently keeps first duplicate series and drops later ones: temp files in /var/prometheus cause silent duplication; solutions are staging under /tmp and atomic mv

nodes.label: Dropped node_nat_traffic Metric
nodes.definition: Architecture decision: Alloy drops unbounded node_nat_traffic before storage (src×dest cross product, no cardinality bound) but it is still exported by router

nodes.label: Validation Test Suite
nodes.definition: Validation scripts: tests/run_all.sh (broad gate), test_mcp_policy.py, test_client_*.sh, test_*.lua, check_exposition.py (live duplicate check)

nodes.label: tests/run_all.sh
nodes.definition: Broad offline validation gate: compiles Python, regenerates v2 dashboards, compares output pairs, checks shell syntax, runs available collector tests

nodes.label: tests/test_mcp_policy.py
nodes.definition: MCP policy and unit test coverage

nodes.label: tests/check_exposition.py
nodes.definition: Optional authorized live duplicate-series check for router metrics endpoint

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.definition: Shared root repository instructions for all agents covering components, safety, validation, and architecture boundaries

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.definition: Claude-specific instructions importing shared AGENTS.md with reference to graphify knowledge graph

nodes.label: .agent/STATUS.md
nodes.definition: Bounded current-state handoff tracking repository readiness improvements, blockers (tracked .env secret), and next actions

nodes.label: .agent/CHANGELOG.md
nodes.definition: Append-only changelog documenting 2026-07-25 changes: shared instructions, bounded handoff files, repository map, agent-readiness work

nodes.label: docs/repository-map.md
nodes.definition: Concise navigation map for agents and contributors showing runtime stack, router code, dashboards, MCP, tests, and docs

nodes.label: docs/CODE-REVIEW-FINDINGS.md
nodes.definition: Long historical code review backlog with severity-tagged findings for router scripts, monitoring host, dashboards, and docs

nodes.label: docs/client-topology-and-netflow-plan.md
nodes.definition: Long historical implementation plan (2348 lines) for client inventory, network graph, traffic attribution with live 2026-07-23 audit notes

nodes.label: prometheus-node-exporter-lua
nodes.definition: Official OpenWrt Prometheus exporter from packages, loads Lua collectors from /usr/lib/lua/prometheus-collectors/

nodes.label: Textfile Collector
nodes.definition: Official prometheus-node-exporter-lua-textfile collector reading metrics from directory (default /var/prometheus)

nodes.label: opkg Package Manager
nodes.definition: OpenWrt 24.10 package manager used by setup.sh to install exporter packages

nodes.label: apk Package Manager
nodes.definition: OpenWrt 25.12+ package manager used by setup.sh as replacement for opkg

nodes.label: Grafana Alerting Rules
nodes.definition: Five provisioned alert rules: unknown_device_joined, client_conntrack_blowup, flow_offload_masking_accounting, client_inventory_unavailable, client_inventory_truncated

nodes.label: Remote Syslog Collection
nodes.definition: OpenWrt logd sends all syslog events to monitoring host UDP port 514 (default) for Alloy to receive and forward to Loki

nodes.label: Dashboard Variable Defaults
nodes.definition: Grafana dashboard variables: WAN interface (wan), 2.4 GHz WiFi AP (phy0-ap0), 5 GHz WiFi AP (phy1-ap0), Tailscale VPN (tailscale0)

nodes.label: Preservation Constraints
nodes.definition: Architecture boundaries: preserve metric names, label sets, datasource variables, dashboard UIDs, ${DS_PROMETHEUS}, ${DS_LOKI}, job=openwrt, router label, $__rate_interval

nodes.label: Generated Dashboard Strategy
nodes.definition: Edit dashboard generators, never generated JSON directly; regenerate outputs and compare manual-import/provisioning pairs

nodes.label: Optional Profile Strategy
nodes.definition: Missing dependencies must fail closed or render explicit unavailable states, never plausible zeroes

nodes.label: Router Compatibility Constraints
nodes.definition: Router code must remain POSIX shell/BusyBox-compatible and Lua 5.1-compatible
